instruction: template.conf contains ${VAR} placeholders. Write render.py substituting from vars.env (KEY=val lines) — unknown vars become empty string. Output to rendered.conf. Run it.

oracle.script:
cat > render.py <<'EOF'
import re
env = dict(l.split('=',1) for l in open('vars.env') if '=' in l)
src = open('template.conf').read()
out = re.sub(r'\$\{(\w+)\}', lambda m: env.get(m.group(1).strip(), '').strip(), src)
open('rendered.conf','w').write(out)
EOF
python3 render.py
